latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Best Video Download — Download and Save Videos Locally:

- Download YouTube and other online videos as 1080p MP4 files via simple prompts.
- Automatic first-time setup with anonymous cloud token and backend connection.
- Supports a wide range of input types including online links, video/audio/image files, and quick batch processing.
- Intuitive keyword/action mapping for prompts: download, export, check credits, show timeline, and more.
- Cloud-based rendering delivers MP4 exports in 20–40 seconds for short clips; up to 500MB file size.
- Clear error handling for token, format, quota, and session issues.
